title: Applications are invited for the appointment of Guest Faculty
text:
KEY LINES:
Dated 14.07.2025
Subject No. of Vacancies
Qualifications:- As per Panjab University/UGC norms.

FULL TEXT:
Off: {2782511, 2534645}
EPABX: 4645, 4647
DEPARTMENT OF EVENING STUDIES-MULTI DISCIPLINARY RESEARCH CENTRE
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014
No. 1152/DES
Dated 14.07.2025
Notice
Applications are invited for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the following subject
for the academic session 2025-2026 (Odd semester) in the Department of Evening
Studies –MDRC, Panjab University, Chandigarh:-
Subject No. of Vacancies
Mathematics = 01
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Working hours
Monday to Friday B.A. 03.00 PM to 9.00 PM
Qualifications:- As per Panjab University/UGC norms.
Salary:- Rs. 1500/- per lecture with the ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month as per
Panjab University norms.
Important Instructions:-
1. The applicants are required to fill the application
form (hard copy only) available at Panjab University website under
employment/jobs (Direct recruitment Assistant Professor application form (As per UGC
Regulation 2018) or directly download via using following web link:-
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2
018.pdf
2. Applicants are required to submit the 05 (five) copies of application
form duly filled in all respect along with one set of the self-attested
copies of the relevant academic testimonials/certificates to the office
of Chairperson, Department of Evening Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh, latest by 2 4 . 0 7 . 2 0 2 5 upto 05:00 PM.
Late applications will not be considered and will stand rejected
automatically. After scrutiny, list of shortlisted candidates for
interview will be displayed on the department’s website. Date of
Interview will be notified later on.
3. The applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification at the time of interview.
4. The applicant shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend from any agency till he/she works in the department as
Guest Faculty.
5. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
6. The date of interview would be intimated later on the email id you provided in the
application form
Sd/-
Chairperson
